tools.name: whoami
tools.title: Who am I
tools.description: Return the signed-in user's id and email as seen by the MCP server. Useful for connection health checks.

tools.name: list_lookups
tools.title: List lookup values
tools.description: Return the names PD HQ matches on: product types, source locations, shipping types, finishing difficulty, chemicals, currencies, assignee codes, company entities and open projects. Call this before import_costing_intake or create_task so names match exactly. Set include_intake_columns to also get every Costing Intake column (header, key, type, how to fill).

include_intake_columns.description: Also return the Costing Intake column list (about 150 columns).

tools.name: list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customers visible to the signed-in user, optionally filtered by a search string on name, company or email.

search.description: Optional text to match against name, company or email.

tools.name: list_inquiries
tools.title: List inquiries
tools.description: List inquiries visible to the signed-in user, newest activity first. Filter by status, customer, or text in the title or inquiry number.

customer_id.description: Optional customer UUID to filter by.

search.description: Optional text to match in the title or inquiry number (e.g. RFQ-2026-014).

tools.name: list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List products visible to the signed-in user, optionally filtered by text in the name or SKU, or by inquiry (customer_rfq) id. Archived products are left out unless include_archived is true.

search.description: Optional text to match in the product name or SKU.

customer_rfq_id.description: Optional inquiry UUID to filter by.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List tasks visible to the signed-in user, soonest due first. Filter to open tasks, or by inquiry, customer, project or assignee code (e.g. CQ).

only_open.description: If true, only tasks with status open.

project_id.description: Only tasks on this project (see list_lookups).

assignee.description: Only tasks for this assignee code (see list_lookups).

tools.name: list_cogs_items
tools.title: List COGS items for a product
tools.description: List the COGS lines on a specific product's costing sheet. Use to look up the id of a line before calling `update_cogs_item`, or to review current unit_cost_inr values.

search.description: Optional case-insensitive substring match on component_name.

tools.name: get_sales_analytics
tools.title: Get sales analytics
tools.description: Read the Analytics page's revenue: real sales (invoiced in Odoo), booked SOs not yet invoiced, and open inquiries weighted by likelihood, by month of the current financial year (April to March), with each quarter, the current quarter and the year, each split into trading and manufacturing. Also confirmed SOs per month and the revenue targets set on the page. Actuals come from the last Odoo sync (synced_at). Read-only.

include_pipeline.description: Count weighted open inquiries in projected and total (default true, like the page's switch).

include_inquiries.description: Also list the pipeline inquiries behind the numbers.

tools.name: find_or_create_customer
tools.title: Find or create a customer
tools.description: Look up a customer by email, then company, then name (exact, case-insensitive). Returns the existing record when one matches and creates a new customer only when none does. New customers default to lead_status active, like the app; lead_status lead also starts the "Customer set to Lead" task rule. Use dry_run to see what would happen without writing.

email.description: Email address; checked first for a match.

source.description: Where the lead came from, e.g. Email, LinkedIn, Referral.

lead_status.description: Only used when creating. Default active.

dry_run.description: Report the match or the record that would be created, without writing.

tools.name: create_inquiry
tools.title: Create an inquiry
tools.description: Create an active inquiry for an existing customer (find it first with find_or_create_customer), with the same Projection defaults as the app's New Inquiry dialog: first company entity sells, the PV entity produces, sea freight, start this month. PD HQ then adds the tasks from the "Inquiry created" rules. If the customer already has an open inquiry with the same title, that one is returned instead unless allow_duplicate is true. Use dry_run to preview.

title.description: Short title, e.g. 'Mango wood serving trays'.

received_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD the inquiry came in. Default today (India).

requirements.description: What the customer asked for: products, sizes, finishes, quantities, target prices.

notes.description: Internal notes, e.g. where the inquiry came from and what was agreed.

quoting_currency.description: Currency code to quote in, e.g. USD. See list_lookups.

target_completion_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD the customer needs the quote or samples by.

drive_url.description: Link to the shared folder with the customer's files and photos.

start_month.description: Projection start month, YYYY-MM. Default this month.

allow_duplicate.description: Create even if an open inquiry with this title exists for the customer.

dry_run.description: Show what would be created, without writing.

tools.name: import_costing_intake
tools.title: Import Costing Intake rows
tools.description: Add or update products on an inquiry from Costing Intake rows, using the same importer as the app's Import products button. Each row is an object keyed by the sheet's headers (e.g. "SKU", "Product name", "Piece W (in)", "Raw piece ₹") or column keys; call list_lookups with include_intake_columns for the full list. Blank or missing cells leave values unchanged. Rows match existing products on the inquiry by SKU, then name. New products are created by default; existing ones are only changed when update_existing is true, and then any category ₹ total or named line item replaces that category's manual COGS rows. Never invent costs: leave ₹ cells out unless the customer or vendor gave them. Run with dry_run first to see the plan and any unknown names. Cached prices and CBM are recalculated by the app when the inquiry is next opened.

rows.description: One object per SKU, keyed by Costing Intake header or key.

create_missing.description: Create products for rows that match nothing (default true).

update_existing.description: Update products that already exist on the inquiry (default false).

dry_run.description: Return the plan and warnings without writing.

tools.name: attach_product_photo
tools.title: Attach a product photo
tools.description: Set a product's main photo from a customer's image (JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB, base64). Stored like a photo uploaded in the app. Refuses to overwrite an existing photo unless replace is true.

image_base64.description: Image bytes as base64; a data: URL prefix is accepted.

dry_run.description: Check the image and product without uploading.

tools.name: create_sample_request
tools.title: Request samples
tools.description: Create a sample request on an inquiry with one line per product, the same as the inquiry's Request samples button. The products' sample stage moves to requested, and PD HQ adds any "Sample requested" tasks. If any of the products already has a pending sample on this inquiry, nothing is created unless allow_duplicate is true. Use dry_run to preview.

product_ids.description: Products on this inquiry to sample.

customer_requested_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD the customer asked for samples.

required_by_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD the samples are needed by.

notes.description: Finish, size or other instructions for the samples.

allow_duplicate.description: Create even if a product already has a pending sample.

tools.name: create_task
tools.title: Create a task
tools.description: Create one task in PD HQ, optionally linked to an inquiry, a customer or a project (by id or exact name, e.g. Sales Office) and optionally recurring. A due date is required. Assignee is a code from list_lookups (e.g. CQ). Nobody is notified. Use dry_run to preview.

project.description: Or the project's exact name, e.g. Sales Office.

mode.description: due = repeat from the due date; completion = repeat from when it is done.

tools.name: add_cogs_item
tools.title: Add COGS item to a product
tools.description: Add a COGS line to a specific product. Resolve the product first with `list_products` (or pass its UUID). Example: to add '520/- raw mango tray' to the HFM Serving Tray, call with product_id, cogs_type='Raw Piece', component_name='Raw Mango Tray', unit_cost_inr=520. cogs_type must be one of: Raw Piece, Subcontracting, Finishing Materials, Packaging, Hardware, Accessories.

component_name.description: Display name of the component, e.g. 'Raw Mango Tray'.

waste_factor.description: Waste factor as a decimal (e.g. 0.05 for 5%).

include.description: Whether to include this line in totals (default Yes).

tools.name: update_cogs_item
tools.title: Update COGS item on a product
tools.description: Update fields (typically unit_cost_inr) on an existing COGS line for a specific product. Identify the row EITHER by `cogs_item_id` OR by (`product_id` + `component_name`, optionally scoped by `cogs_type`). First resolve the product with `list_products`, then optionally call `list_cogs_items` to see current lines. Only provided fields are changed. Refuses to update auto-calculated rows unless `force=true`.

cogs_item_id.description: Direct UUID of the cogs_items row to update.

product_id.description: Product UUID (required if cogs_item_id not given).

component_name.description: Component name to match (case-insensitive) when cogs_item_id not given.

cogs_type.description: Optional category to disambiguate the match.

tools.name: list_sales_pipeline
tools.title: List the sales pipeline
tools.description: Accounts in the pipeline (optionally one stage or one account) with their contacts, latest messages and open follow-ups.

tools.name: check_can_contact
tools.title: Check before sending
tools.description: Every sender (LinkedIn invites and messages, email, drip, WhatsApp, anything new) calls this right before sending. Returns allowed or the reason it is blocked: do not contact on the person or account, not a fit, not now until a date, never email, missing address. Blocked sends are logged. People PD HQ does not know come back allowed with known false.

tools.name: upsert_sales_account
tools.title: Find or add a sales account
tools.description: Find an account by domain, then exact company name, or add it as a prospect in Queued (prospects fire no Lead task rules). On a match, fills empty fields and updates persona, type, fit score and owner; the stage only moves through set_sales_stage. Use dry_run first.

customer_type.description: e.g. furniture importer, decor e-commerce, Amazon seller.

source.description: e.g. Apollo TAM, Waalaxy list name, website form.

sales_stage.description: Only used when the account has no stage yet. Default queued.

tools.name: upsert_contact
tools.title: Find or add a contact
tools.description: Find a person by LinkedIn URL, then email, or add them (a new person needs one of the two). Sets engaged (said more than thanks), drip enrolment, email lookup results and Waalaxy/Apollo ids. Never sets or clears do not contact: use set_do_not_contact. Use dry_run first.

engaged.description: True once they say more than thanks for connecting. Only engaged people get nudges.

drip_enrolled.description: Really interested: on the long-term update drip.

linkedin_account.description: Which seat they are connected to, e.g. Caleb or Parker.

tools.name: log_touch
tools.title: Log a message
tools.description: Log one message in or out on LinkedIn, email, WhatsApp, a call or a meeting. Pass the channel's message id as external_id so repeated syncs never double-log. Outbound to do not contact is refused. An inbound message moves a Queued or In outreach account to Responded; a first outbound moves Queued to In outreach. A/B fields (variant, test_name, angle, persona, step, opener_type) go on outbound messages. Use dry_run first.

sender_account.description: Our side, e.g. linkedin:caleb, linkedin:parker, gmail:caleb.

auto_sent.description: Sent by a job without Caleb's review (e.g. thanks for connecting).

engaged.description: Inbound that says more than thanks: marks the person engaged.

tools.name: set_sales_stage
tools.title: Move an account's stage
tools.description: Move an account to queued, in_outreach, responded, in_conversation, inquiry, customer, not_now (needs not_now_until) or not_a_fit, with a one-line reason kept on the stage log. For removal requests use set_do_not_contact. Use dry_run first.

actor.description: e.g. crm-watchdog. Default the signed-in user.

tools.name: set_do_not_contact
tools.title: Set do not contact
tools.description: Removal request: sets the master do-not-contact flag on the person (or the whole account), which stops their drip, sets never-email, skips open drafts and moves a whole account to Do not contact. Only Caleb can clear it, in PD HQ. The reply lists what to do outside PD HQ (Waalaxy, email lists). Use dry_run first.

reason.description: e.g. 'Asked to be removed, LinkedIn 23 Nov'.

source.description: Where they asked: linkedin, email, whatsapp, call, other.

whole_account.description: Also flag the account, covering every contact there.

tools.name: save_brief
tools.title: Save an account brief
tools.description: Save the brief shown at the top of the account page, part by part, each with its source link. Parts: company, products_close_to_ours, market, india_buying, qualification, conversation_so_far, suggested_next_move, watch_outs. Parts not given are kept. Optionally set the next step and its date. Use dry_run first.

tools.name: save_follow_up
tools.title: Save a follow-up and its draft
tools.description: Create or update a follow-up task on an account, beside Caleb's other tasks: a reply he owes, or nudge 1 to 3 (1 week, 1 month, 1 quarter; engaged people only), with the drafted message for his approval. Statuses: draft, approved, sent, skipped (sent and skipped close the task). Refuses a draft to someone who cannot be contacted. Use dry_run first.

task_id.description: Update this follow-up instead of creating one.

assignee.description: Default the account owner, else CQ.

tools.name: log_job_run
tools.title: Log a job run
tools.description: Every playbook job (crm-watchdog, outreach, list-building, waalaxy-ops, drip, ...) calls this at the end of a run: status, a one-line summary, counts, credits used, cost in USD and how many items wait for Caleb. Feeds the Jobs tab. Use dry_run first.

tools.name: list_traction_board
tools.title: Read the Traction bullseye
tools.description: The 19 Traction channels with their ring (inner holds at most 3, the ones being tested now), each channel's top 5 open ideas, inquiries tagged to each channel, and the communities list with interaction plans. Read this before proposing channel work.

tools.name: save_traction_idea
tools.title: Add or update a Traction idea
tools.description: Add an idea to a channel (status proposed, or not for now when paid), or update one by id: rank, pitch, evidence, status, decision note. Ideas Caleb approves become tasks from the app. Never moves a channel's ring. Use dry_run first.

tools.name: save_community
tools.title: Add or update a community
tools.description: Find a community (forum, group, newsletter, association) by name and update its status, interaction plan, who acts, last and next touch; or add it as a candidate. Use dry_run first.

tools.name: list_content
tools.title: List content and the posting calendar
tools.description: Content pieces (posts, articles, case studies, charts, drips) and the posting calendar with scores, default 2 weeks back to 8 weeks ahead.

tools.name: save_content
tools.title: Add or update a content piece
tools.description: Add a piece or update it by id or slug (body, status, proof, target search, cut-from parent), and add or update its calendar slots (one per channel and date) with variant, test and the 3-day score: qualified comments, profile views, accepts. Posts go on Caleb's profile only, through Buffer, after he approves. Use dry_run first.

parent_slug.description: The long piece this was cut from.

tools.name: search_prospects
tools.title: Search prospects
tools.description: Search every company in Prospects (full TAM, filtered TAM, persona lists, weekly picks, trade buyers, Waalaxy, Apollo) by text and filter by list ids, prospect type, tier (A-D, X failed the fit gate), country, tag and status. Best first by default. Companies that failed the fit gate are hidden unless lists includes tam-raw or a status is given. include_facets adds the lists with counts.

tools.name: set_prospect_rank
tools.title: Move a prospect up or down
tools.description: Move a prospect one tier up (move 1) or down (move -1), set its tier (A-D, or auto to go back to the score), or pin it to the top of its tier. A reason is required and is logged. Caleb's own moves come first: do not undo a tier he set unless he asks. Use dry_run first.

tools.name: promote_prospect
tools.title: Put a prospect into the pipeline
tools.description: Add a prospect to the Sales pipeline as a Queued account with its people as contacts, or link it to the account already in the CRM (matched on domain, then name). Refuses do not contact. Use dry_run first.

tools.name: import_prospects
tools.title: Load prospects
tools.description: Load up to 500 companies (and their people) into Prospects, optionally onto a list, e.g. this week's picks (kind weekly_outreach, id weekly-main-YYYY-MM-DD). Matches on domain, then name and country, so nothing is doubled; links accounts already in the CRM and carries do not contact over. Never overwrites a tier set by hand. replace_list clears the list's old members first. The full monthly run goes through Sales > Prospects > Load file instead. Use dry_run first.
